summary: User-reported UX bug: returning from History to the Gallery leaves a media-hungry op selected with an empty PromptBox, so Run only toasts a missing-input complaint. Fix is to reuse the existing clear-last-image fallback on Gallery re-entry: no media => t2i, media present => leave the op alone.

Implementation started, user scheduled it into 1.3. Root cause is the MPI-247 op memory: MpiGalleryBlock seeds the op from getSelectedOp(activeModelId) with no regard for media, so any media-hungry pick is restored onto an empty box on the next Gallery mount. Not History-specific. MPI-356 drop-to-text-op is gated on hadMedia, a transition, so mount never fires it. Fix runs post-mount off the box live counts and after _wirePromptBox so operation-change is heard, programmatic true so the user pick returns with media. Gallery-scoped, no overlap with MPI-387.

USER-VERIFIED live, all four acceptance cases. Shipped as one shared decision: pickTextOnlyOp + isTextOnlyOp in commandRegistry, MPI-356 branch extracted to _dropToTextOp(), el.dropToTextOpIfEmpty() fired by MpiGalleryBlock after _wirePromptBox and the count sync. Reuse path excluded. New test 4/4, suite 269/278 with the same 9 known failures, eslint clean. No changelog entry - MPI-356 shipped after 1.2.0 so the regression never reached a user. docs/generation-lifecycle.md documents the two force-DOWN exceptions.
